h2_pathways.description: Default H2 production pathway for standalone execution. Set in the UI at runtime.

h2_pricing.description: H2 pricing mode for standalone model execution. Set use_schedule or use_curve to true to enable that mode.

truck_defaults.description: Default truck fleet parameters. Actual values are sent by the UI at runtime; these serve as fallbacks for standalone execution.

uptime.description: Fleet utilization by SIMULATION year, not truck age: year_1 = the first simulation year (2026), year_2 = the second (2027), default = every year from the third (2028) onward. Ramps 30% -> 60% -> 100% as the fleet and refuelling network mature.

truck_defaults.comment_annual_basis: 38 kg/day x 250 operating days = 9,500 kg/truck/year at full utilization; at miles_per_kg_h2 = 9 (tco_config.json) that is 85,500 miles/truck/year.

hri.description: HRI (Hydrogen Refueling Infrastructure) LCFS credit parameters. Stations below the utilization threshold receive credits for unused capacity.

station_projection.description: Automatic station projection after the user-defined pipeline ends.

station_config.description: Station and truck deployment mode. Set to false to use probabilistic (stochastic) deployment instead of config files.

stochastic_fallback.description: Parameters for probabilistic station/truck deployment. Only active when use_station_config_file or use_truck_deployment_schedule is false. Currently not in use — the model always reads from config files.
